Hi Julie — thanks for the CSV and the prompt. Looping in Kimberly from AP ops and Vanessa from vendor onboarding so we can align on the intake contract.

High level from our side: portal-first is preferred for EU suppliers (faster acks, better line-item parsing). That said, we do support an SMTP fallback for the first 30 days while portal setup completes — we flag those invoices and apply additional manual matching. Things I need to confirm:
1) PO stamping: we can accept PO number in a CSV column named PO_NUMBER or in the email subject (Subject token: PO:<po-number>). If you include PO_NUMBER per row that's ideal for automated matching.
2) VAT: we require line-level VAT_RATE and VAT_AMOUNT when multiple VAT rates apply across line items. If it's a single invoice-level VAT, VAT_TOTAL is fine.
3) Idempotency: filename + invoice_number is our primary dedupe key. Good filename pattern: acme_INV_<YYYYMMDD>_<invoice_number>.csv.

Attached is our onboarding form (vendor_onboarding_form.pdf) with the minimal fields. Kimberly — can you paste the compact sample rows we prefer and the ack behavior? Vanessa — any expected lead time for portal onboarding for Acme?

Thanks for the context — short answer: portal-first, SMTP fallback OK for a short window. Here are the AP intake requirements (compact):

Mandatory columns for CSV intake:
- invoice_number (string)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- supplier_id (your vendor ID)
- po_number (optional, but required for PO-backed invoices)
- currency (ISO 4217)
- line_description (short text)
- line_amount (numeric)
- vat_rate (percent, optional per-line)
- vat_amount (numeric, optional per-line)

Minimal idempotency check: filename + invoice_number + supplier_id. If we see a duplicate within 14 days we return a 409 with the previous intake timestamp. For SMTP fallback: put the same CSV as an attachment and include the subject token: [ACME-PO:<po_number>] or Subject: ACME_INV <invoice_number>.

Sample compact CSV row we prefer (comma-delimited):
acme_INV_20250915_1001,2025-09-15,ACME-12345,PO-7788,EUR,Consulting fees,5000,20,1000

Acks and SLA:
- Portal uploads: immediate 200 + intake_id in response, human review only if PO fails to match.
- SMTP attachments: automated parse within 30 minutes; if parsing fails we send an NACK with reason and a link to retry.

Drive doc with onboarding checklist and template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/EXAMPLE_ONBOARDING_DOCS

Vanessa — typical portal activation for an EU supplier is 3–5 business days once we have the onboarding form and sample invoices.
